heading.en: The pool is deeper than it looks

hook.en: Look into a clear pond: the bottom seems close enough to touch. Step in and the water is up to your waist. Refraction fools the eye.
hook.kn: ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಕೊಳದೊಳಗೆ ನೋಡಿದರೆ ತಳ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಳಿದರೆ ನೀರು ಸೊಂಟದವರೆಗೆ. ವಕ್ರೀಭವನ ಕಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Relate refractive index to the speed of light

narration.en: Look into a clear pond: the bottom seems close enough to touch. Step in and the water is up to your waist. Refraction fools the eye.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಕೊಳದೊಳಗೆ ನೋಡಿದರೆ ತಳ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಳಿದರೆ ನೀರು ಸೊಂಟದವರೆಗೆ. ವಕ್ರೀಭವನ ಕಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: When light crosses from medium 1 to medium 2, the incident ray, the refracted ray and the normal lie in one plane, and $\sin i/\sin r = n_{21} = n_2/n_1$. The refractive index of a medium is $n = c/v$. Going into a denser medium the ray bends towards the normal. The frequency stays the same; the speed and wavelength fall.
body.kn: ಸ್ನೆಲ್ ನಿಯಮ: sin i / sin r = n₂₁. ವಕ್ರೀಭವನ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ n = c/v. ಸಾಂದ್ರ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುವಾಗ ಕಿರಣ ಲಂಬದ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಬಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: An object at depth $h$ in a medium of refractive index $n$, seen from air nearly normally, appears at depth $h/n$. It seems raised by $h(1 - 1/n)$.
body.kn: n ವಕ್ರೀಭವನ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕದ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮದಲ್ಲಿ h ಆಳದ ವಸ್ತು h/n ಆಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದು h(1 − 1/n) ರಷ್ಟು ಮೇಲೆ ಏರಿದಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.

aim.en: To find the refractive index of a glass slab using a travelling microscope.

narration.en: Using a travelling microscope we measure the real and apparent depth of a mark under a glass slab, and their ratio gives the refractive index.

problem.en: A ray in air falls at 60° on a glass surface of refractive index √3. Find the angle of refraction.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A ray in air falls at 60° on a glass surface of refractive index √3. Find the angle of refraction.

problem.en: A tank holds water (n = 4/3) 12 cm deep. How deep does it look from above, and by how much is the bottom raised?

points.en: n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r.
points.kn: n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r.

points.en: n = c/v; frequency does not change on refraction.

narration.en: Recap. n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r. n = c/v; frequency does not change on refraction. Apparent depth = real depth / n.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r. n = c/v; ವಕ್ರೀಭವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ತೋರಿಕೆಯ ಆಳ = ನೈಜ ಆಳ / n.
